board.bio:
Prof. Aalap Patel is an Assistant Professor at the Unitedworld Institute of Management, Karnavati University, Gandhinagar, India. She possesses an interdisciplinary academic background encompassing Organisational and Educational Psychology, Corporate and Educational Law, and Educational Management. She holds master’s degrees in Law, Education, and Psychology from Gujarat University, along with a Ph.D. specialising in Organisational and Educational Psychology. With over 16 years of academic experience, she has contributed extensively to teaching, research, and academic development. She also holds an additional master’s qualification in French and serves as an Examiner and Course Setter for the International Baccalaureate Board, Geneva.

Her research interests include educational psychology, organisational behaviour, personality and self-concept, student well-being, educational technology, sustainable higher education, human resource management, corporate governance, behavioral finance, and the psychological dimensions of workplace dynamics. Her scholarly work explores the intersection of psychological processes, organisational practices, educational innovation, and sustainable development. She has contributed to academic scholarship through publications in Scopus-indexed journals, books, book chapters, and conference proceedings, reflecting her commitment to interdisciplinary research and the advancement of knowledge in management, education, and behavioral sciences.

Further details regarding her academic and professional activities are available on her LinkedIn profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aalap-patel-7850b1163/

board.bio: Dr. Malay Patel is an Associate Professor of Management at Unitedworld Insitute of Management, Karnavati University, Gujarat, India. He possesses over 16 years of combined experience across academia, industry, and interdisciplinary research. He holds a Ph.D. in Business Studies along with M.Sc. in Paints and Polymers Sciences and an M.B.A. in Marketing and Human Resource Management. His research interests include Cultural Studies, entrepreneurship, sustainability, strategic management, innovation, business ethics, Indian Knowledge Systems, and interdisciplinary social sciences. Dr. Patel has published research papers, books, book chapters, teaching cases, and conference proceedings in national and international academic platforms. He has also been academically associated with institutions such as IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, and Warsaw University, Poland. Dr. Patel’s academic work integrates management education with socio-cultural, ethical, and sustainability-oriented perspectives, with a special focus on emerging economies and interdisciplinary research approaches.

board.bio:
Dr. Santosh Kumar Yadav is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Operations
and IT at the Faculty of Management, IBS Hyderabad, IFHE, India. He brings over three years of teaching experience as a Lecturer at the Patel Group of Institutions, Indore, and more than two years of experience as an Academic
Associate (AA) in the Operations
Management and Quantitative Techniques (OM & QT) area at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore. A science graduate with a postgraduate degree in management, Dr. Santosh Kumar Yadav has actively participated in national and international conferences, presenting his
research both in India and abroad. Recently he has received SAP University Alliances Educational Excellence Membership Award
2026 on behalf of IFHE Hyderabad at Jakarta. He is a certified ERPsim Level 1 Instructor and GBI S/4 HANA 4.2 and SAP Analytics Cloud trainer and holds lifetime memberships in several professional bodies
including the Society of Operations
Management (SOM), the Operational Research Society of
India (ORSI), the Analytics Society of India (ASI), and AIMS International.
